test_take_basic: test the Series.take method to retrieve elements by positive integer indices
test_take_negative_indices: test the Series.take method to retrieve elements by negative integer indices
test_take_out_of_bounds: test that Series.take raises IndexError when indices are out of bounds
test_take_categorical: test the Series.take method on a Series with categorical data
test_take_slice_raises: test that Series.take raises TypeError when passed a slice instead of a sequence
